title: What is one half?
examples: Are both halves the same size?
How do I find half of 8?

explain.say: You and a friend share 1 roti. You both want a fair share. Look at the board. The roti is cut into 2 equal parts. The shaded part is one half.
Now both parts are shaded. 2 halves make the whole roti again. A half is 1 of 2 equal parts. Equal means the same size.
Halves can be any shape. This bar is cut into 2 equal parts. One half is shaded. We write it as 1 over 2. The 2 means 2 equal parts.
You can find half of a group too. Share 8 grapes between 2 people. Each person gets 4. So half of 8 is 4. What is half of 6?
Halves are always the same size. Fold a paper in half. Check that the 2 parts match. Can you fold it in half a different way?

faq.a: Half means one of 2 equal parts. If you cut an apple into 2 pieces that are exactly the same size, each piece is one half.

faq.q: Are both halves the same size?
faq.a: Yes, always. If one piece is bigger, the pieces are not halves. Halves must be equal.

faq.q: How do I find half of 8?
faq.a: Share 8 into 2 equal groups. Each group has 4, so half of 8 is 4.

faq.q: How do I write one half?
faq.a: Write 1 over 2, with a line between them. The 2 at the bottom means 2 equal parts, and the 1 on top means you have one of them.

faq.q: How many halves make a whole?
faq.a: 2 halves make one whole. Put both halves of the roti back together and you have the whole roti.

facts: Half of an even number is a whole number: half of 8 is 4.

quiz.say: A pizza is cut into 1 big piece and 1 small piece. Are they halves?

quiz.why: Halves are 2 equal parts. Both pieces must be the same size.

wrong.0: 2 pieces is a good start, but they must also be the same size.
wrong.1: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts, so the pieces must match.

quiz.why: Share 10 into 2 equal groups. Each group has 5.

wrong.1: 2 is the number of groups. Count how many are in each group.
wrong.2: 20 is double 10. A half is smaller than the whole.
